effects.label: Bats
effects.description: Animated bat swarms with orbit, directional movement, lateral drift, and optional shadows.

parameters.label: Below Tokens
parameters.description: Places Bats behind token artwork in the effect stack. This changes whether tokens appear in front of the effect; it does not change where the effect is generated.

parameters.label: Below Tiles
parameters.description: Places Bats below overhead tile artwork. Enable it when roofs, canopies, or other overhead tiles should cover the effect.

parameters.label: Below Foreground
parameters.tooltip: Renders effects underneath foreground coverage visually.
parameters.description: Places Bats below foreground coverage so foreground artwork can visually cover the effect.

parameters.label: Levels
parameters.tooltip: Limit this scene effect to selected scene levels. Leave All Levels selected to render everywhere.
parameters.description: Limits Bats to the selected Scene Levels. Leave All Levels selected when the effect should appear at every elevation.

parameters.label: Tint
parameters.description: Applies the selected color tint to bats. Disable Apply to keep the effect's original colors.

parameters.label: Sound FX
parameters.description: Enables audio for Bats when a matching active FXMaster+ SoundFX rule is available. This setting does not create sound by itself.

parameters.label: Sound FX Sounds
parameters.tooltip: Choose which sounds are eligible when a matching manual SoundFX rule supplies multiple sounds.
parameters.description: Limits Bats to selected sounds when a matching enabled SoundFX rule uses Multi-Sound Mode = Manual with at least two configured sounds. Leave the selection empty to use the rule's normal sound selection.
parameters.availabilityDetail: the matching enabled SoundFX rule uses Multi-Sound Mode = Manual with at least two configured sounds

parameters.label: Orbit
parameters.description: Makes bats circulate around the effect area instead of only crossing the canvas in a straight or drifting path.

parameters.label: Orbit Distance
parameters.description: Controls the radius of the path used while Orbit is enabled. Higher values keep bats farther from the orbit center.

parameters.label: Shadow
parameters.description: Adds a separate projected shadow beneath bats to give the effect more depth against the map.

parameters.label: Shadow Only
parameters.description: Hides bats and renders only their projected shadows.

parameters.label: Shadow Position
parameters.description: Sets the direction the projected shadow falls relative to the visible particle.

parameters.label: Shadow Distance
parameters.description: Controls how far the projected shadow is offset from the visible particle.

parameters.label: Shadow Blur
parameters.description: Controls how soft the projected shadow edges appear.

parameters.label: Shadow Opacity
parameters.description: Controls the transparency of the projected shadows.

parameters.label: Lateral Movement
parameters.description: Adds side-to-side drift to bats while they travel. Higher values create wider lateral movement around the main path.

parameters.label: Directional Movement
parameters.description: Makes bats travel in the configured Direction instead of relying only on the effect's default random movement.

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.description: Sets the primary travel direction for bats. Directional Spread can add variation around this angle.

parameters.label: Directional Spread
parameters.description: Adds random angular variation around Direction so bats do not all travel along the same line.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.description: Changes the rendered size of bats. It does not change how many particles are present.

parameters.label: Speed
parameters.description: Changes how quickly bats move and animate across the canvas. It does not change particle size or count.

parameters.label: Lifetime
parameters.description: Changes how long individual bats remain active before they are recycled or replaced. Higher values usually allow longer travel paths.

parameters.label: Density
parameters.description: Changes how many bats are visible or spawned at once. It does not change their size.

parameters.label: Opacity
parameters.description: Controls the transparency of bats. Lower values allow more of the map to show through.

parameters.label: Darkness Activation
parameters.tooltip: Only render the effect while scene darkness is within the configured range.
parameters.description: Restricts Bats to a configured Scene Darkness range instead of rendering at every darkness level.

parameters.label: Darkness Activation Range
parameters.tooltip: Minimum and maximum scene darkness values where the effect remains active.
parameters.description: Sets the minimum and maximum Scene Darkness values where Bats remains visible.

parameters.label: Y Adjustment
parameters.tooltip: Shift the rendered particle field vertically by grid spaces.
parameters.description: Moves the automatically distributed custom particle field vertically in grid spaces. This does not move individually placed particles.

parameters.label: Horizontal Flip
parameters.tooltip: Mirrors the particle sprite horizontally when enabled.
parameters.description: Mirrors manually placed custom images horizontally without changing their position, scale, or direction.

parameters.label: Manual Placement Controls
parameters.tooltip: Controls for placing, deleting, or clearing manually placed custom images on the current Scene.
parameters.description: Opens the controls used to place custom images, delete a selected placement, or clear every placement for this effect.

parameters.label: Light Source
parameters.tooltip: Creates and manages Foundry ambient light sources for manually placed fire particles on the current Scene.
parameters.description: Creates and manages Foundry ambient light sources for manually placed fire particles on the current Scene.

parameters.label: Light Color
parameters.tooltip: Color used by the linked Foundry ambient light source.
parameters.description: Color used by the linked Foundry ambient light source.

parameters.label: Light Radius
parameters.tooltip: Dim light radius for each manually placed fire, measured in grid spaces.
parameters.description: Dim light radius for each manually placed fire, measured in grid spaces.

parameters.label: Bright Radius
parameters.tooltip: Bright light radius for each manually placed fire, measured in grid spaces. This cannot exceed the dim light radius.
parameters.description: Bright light radius for each manually placed fire, measured in grid spaces. This cannot exceed the dim light radius.

parameters.label: Light Intensity
parameters.tooltip: Color intensity and opacity of the linked Foundry ambient light source.
parameters.description: Color intensity and opacity of the linked Foundry ambient light source.

parameters.label: Light Flicker
parameters.tooltip: Torch animation strength for the linked Foundry ambient light source. Set to 0 for a steady light.
parameters.description: Torch animation strength for the linked Foundry ambient light source. Set to 0 for a steady light.

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.tooltip: Direction in degrees using geometric coordinates: 0° points right on the x-axis, 90° points up, and angles increase counterclockwise.
parameters.description: Sets the orientation or travel direction used by the custom images.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.description: Changes the rendered size of each custom image. In Manual Placement, this affects the placed images as well as automatically distributed particles.

parameters.label: Density
parameters.description: Changes how many automatically distributed custom images are active at once. It does not change the number of manually placed images.

parameters.label: Opacity
parameters.description: Controls the transparency of the custom images.

parameters.label: Flicker
parameters.tooltip: How strongly the fire brightness and shape pulse over time. Lower values are steadier; higher values create more visible flaring.
parameters.description: How strongly the fire brightness and shape pulse over time. Lower values are steadier; higher values create more visible flaring.

parameters.label: Glow
parameters.description: Controls the brightness of the glow applied around each custom image.

parameters.label: Glow Radius
parameters.description: Controls how far the glow extends beyond each custom image.

parameters.label: Burn Tokens
parameters.tooltip: Applies a client-side token-shaped pulsing heat and smoke indicator to visible tokens that pass through this particle fire effect.
parameters.description: Applies a client-side token-shaped pulsing heat and smoke indicator to visible tokens that pass through this particle fire effect.

parameters.label: Burn Duration
parameters.tooltip: Seconds the visual burn remains after the token leaves the fire. Re-entering the fire refreshes this timer.
parameters.description: Seconds the visual burn remains after the token leaves the fire. Re-entering the fire refreshes this timer.

parameters.label: Burn Trigger Radius
parameters.tooltip: How close a token must be to a fire particle source or manual fire placement to trigger burning, measured in grid spaces.
parameters.description: How close a token must be to a fire particle source or manual fire placement to trigger burning, measured in grid spaces.

parameters.label: Burn Visual Scale
parameters.tooltip: Coverage multiplier for the pulsing burn indicator. Heat stays clipped to the token artwork alpha; values above 0.5 allow ember and smoke detail to drift just beyond the token shape.
parameters.description: Coverage multiplier for the pulsing burn indicator. Heat stays clipped to the token artwork alpha; values above 0.5 allow ember and smoke detail to drift just beyond the token shape.

parameters.label: Burn Opacity
parameters.tooltip: Maximum opacity of the token-shaped pulsing burn indicator.
parameters.description: Maximum opacity of the token-shaped pulsing burn indicator.

parameters.label: Burn Pulse Detail
parameters.tooltip: Controls the amount of smoke, ember, and pulse detail blended into each burning token.
parameters.description: Controls the amount of smoke, ember, and pulse detail blended into each burning token.

parameters.label: Burn Tint
parameters.tooltip: Optional override color for the token burn pulse. Disable Apply to use the fire particle tint or the default orange heat color.
parameters.description: Optional override color for the token burn pulse. Disable Apply to use the fire particle tint or the default orange heat color.

parameters.label: Darkness Activation
parameters.tooltip: Only render the effect while scene darkness is within the configured range.
parameters.description: Restricts Manual Placement to a configured Scene Darkness range instead of rendering at every darkness level.

parameters.label: Darkness Activation Range
parameters.tooltip: Minimum and maximum scene darkness values where the effect remains active.
parameters.description: Sets the minimum and maximum Scene Darkness values where Manual Placement remains visible.

customParticleBases.label: Sound Only
customParticleBases.description: Custom particle base that creates no visual emitters and exists only to activate matching SoundFX rules.

parameters.label: Sound FX
parameters.description: Allows the Sound Only effect to activate a matching FXMaster+ SoundFX rule. The effect does not create visual particles.

parameters.label: Sound FX Sounds
parameters.tooltip: Choose which sounds are eligible when a matching manual SoundFX rule supplies multiple sounds.
parameters.description: Limits the Sound Only effect to the selected sounds when its matching manual SoundFX rule contains multiple choices.
parameters.availabilityDetail: the matching enabled SoundFX rule uses Multi-Sound Mode = Manual with at least two configured sounds
